title: Relic gardener
lore: Tended a garden beneath a dying artificial sun. Their seed case still hums.

title: Battlefield healer
lore: Kept strangers alive through the collapse of the Ninth Meridian.

title: Chronal salvager
lore: Recovered machines from a city whose tomorrow never arrived.

title: Exiled warden
lore: Abandoned a fortress rather than obey an order to seal its refugee gates.

title: Fractal cartographer
lore: Mapped routes between incompatible histories and lost the way home.
